present. Something you give someone on a special day.

money. Coins and paper you use to buy things.
compare. To look at how things are the same or different.
shopping. Going to stores to buy things.
beggar. A poor person who asks people for money or food.
card. A small plastic card you use to pay.
charity. A group that helps people in need.
love. A very strong, warm feeling for someone.
